rules: Read AGENTS.md before starting any task.
Read the full task file in tasks/ before writing any code.
Never hardcode API keys or tokens in any file.
Never commit local.properties or any file containing secrets.
Always run assembleDebug and confirm BUILD SUCCESSFUL before committing.
One task per commit. Use the commit message from the task file.
Do not modify AGENTS.md, opencode.json or task files unless explicitly instructed.
